act.long_title: An Act to provide a general Penal Code for India.

section.heading: Abetment of mutiny, if mutiny is committed in consequence thereof
section.html:
Whoever abets the committing of mutiny by an officer,

soldier, [sailor or airman], in the Army, [Navy or Air Force] of the [Government of India], shall, if mutiny be committed in consequence of that abetment, be punished with death or with [imprisonment for life], or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
